body:
After long thought I decided to part ways. Main reasons are as follows: 
- the app is very hard to use. 
Not to mention asked for a. Personal video to “”verify “ it was me using the app !!!!! Of course it’s me. 
I am seriously concerned about this bank privacy practices. 
- Not flexible. It takes ages to get anything done. 
- it feels like they are doing me a favor I don’t know if you feel it too ;)
- the entire vibe is just very admin heavy this is ok for 1990 but we are past 1990’s

Two stars because some of the employees are really good.

title: Telesales Agent -Disappointing Experience
body:
I have always heard great reviews about ADIB from my friends, which is why I was confident in approaching the bank for a loan. However, my experience with your telesales agent, Mohammed Nour, has been highly disappointing.

From the very first conversation via phone, Mohammed appeared diligent and asked me to send my documents. I complied, but to my surprise, he requested that I send everything via WhatsApp rather than through email, which seemed unusual. I was transparent in sharing all the necessary details, including potential issues related to my low AECB score and my company’s profile, so that I could understand upfront if I was eligible for the loan.

Despite my concerns, Mohammed assured me that the loan would be approved. He continued to promise the same since the first week of November. However, last week, I received a call from him stating that the loan could not be sanctioned, citing the very reasons I had brought up during our first conversation.

What made the situation worse was Mohammed’s lack of professionalism. He repeatedly failed to answer or return my calls, leaving me in the dark about the status of my application. When I confronted him about his unresponsiveness, he simply stated that he was too busy, which is unacceptable when dealing with customers’ financial matters.

This experience has not only caused me inconvenience but also shattered the trust I had in ADIB based on its reputation. I urge the bank to look into this matter seriously to ensure better training and accountability for your telesales agents. Transparency and timely communication should be the cornerstone of your customer service.

I hope ADIB takes corrective measures to prevent other customers from facing similar issues.

title: Transactions Processing Error and Delay
body:
I am using this app from almost 7 months. And I am very disappointed with ADIB Bank services. As from 3 days I am continually facing the technical error of app to send money to my family which not resolve until today. Additionally, when I send my money to my any beneficiary, it takes 3 days to delivered in their accounts. ADIB hold the payments to process them after 3 days. 
Now I am changing my mind to move on any other banks as their customer care centre also never ever answer.
I am strong not recommending this bank to all of you. Please don’t open an account with ADIB.

Best regards..

title: Poor covered card support services
body:
Dear Sir,

I got a covered card from ADIB and within 2 days my ADIB credit was blocked by the bank without prior notice and for no valid cause. I contacted customer service, and when I inquired about the cause, they informed me that they were unable to advise me of the issue. It is incredibly unfortunate that as a customer, I am not allowed to know why my card was blocked without receiving at least an SMS or email from them.    

I’m living in UAE almost 7 years, never had such bad experience from any bank in UAE, I am not sure why my card was canceled; it is really disappointing, and they want me to pay the annual fee for this blocked card.

title: طريقة البحث
body:
انا اتمنى من بنك مثل هذا المستوى ان يحسن من طريقة البحث في موضوع تحويل الاموال مب حاله هاي انا اقعد ١٠ دقايق ادور ع اسم المستفيد ليش ما اقدر ابحث عن طريق رقم الحساب و اخلص و افتك اذا مثلا مسجل عندي ٤ محمد لازم ادخل ع واحد واحد ادور ع رقم حساب الشخص المعني
و اذا ناسي انا شو مسجل الشخص هذا و عندي لسته طويله باسامي الناس نفترض عندي ف التطبيق ٤٠ شخص مسجل و الشخص الي ابا ارسل المبلغ له ناسي شو مسجل عليه اقعد ادخل حساب حساب لين اعرف رقم حساب الشخص
لدرجه ان عادي اطلع من اديب و السبب هذا الموضوع جوفو حل خلو الناس ترتاح تبحث عن طريق رقم الحساب

body:
